title: SecureObs - DevSecOps Security Observatory Platform
description: Production-deployed, multi-tenant security SaaS that unifies seven open-source scanners into one triage dashboard with cross-tool deduplication, SARIF export, CI/CD build gates, and credential-free Terraform attack-path analysis.
role: Solo architect, full-stack engineer, and security platform builder
highlights: Unifies Semgrep, Gitleaks, Trivy, Bandit, ESLint-security, OSV-Scanner, and Checkov with canonical deduplication.
Fails CI/CD pipelines on unresolved blocking findings and exports SARIF for developer workflows.
Parses Terraform without cloud credentials, builds a typed Azure resource graph, and ranks chained attack paths.
Enforces tenant isolation with app-layer authorization plus PostgreSQL FORCE row-level security under a restricted role.
Runs scans in ephemeral sandboxed Azure Container Instances with short-lived tokens and project-scoped API keys.

title: Security Tooling Portfolio - Python Microservices
description: Three independent security microservices covering vulnerability scanning, security assessment orchestration, and network traffic analysis with async processing, validated APIs, and Kubernetes deployment objects.

title: Cloud Security Labs & Write-ups
description: Hands-on Azure Firewall, Terraform, and network-isolation labs documenting secure landing-zone patterns, cloud hardening decisions, and practical security tradeoffs.

title: DevSecOps CI/CD Security Gates
description: Reference CI/CD pipeline integrating SAST, dependency vulnerability checks, container scanning, infrastructure-as-code security validation, and automated security testing gates.

title: SIEM Detection Pack (Microsoft Sentinel)
description: KQL-based detection rules for Microsoft Sentinel targeting suspicious authentication, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and data exfiltration with MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

title: Secure API Gateway Pattern
description: API gateway pattern implementing JWT authentication, rate limiting, request validation, SQL injection prevention, XSS protection, and structured logging for OWASP API Top 10 mitigations.
